_meta.title: Affiliate link configuration — data-driven, no code change to add merchants
_meta.how: The injector reads this file. Amazon works from AMAZON_ASSOC_TAG env alone (search links). Other networks need a per-advertiser deeplink template you copy from your network dashboard: use {url} for the destination and {tag}/{campaign} where the network requires them.
_meta.disclosure: FTC affiliate disclosure is injected separately by stream-ops produce(); links here are always presented under a disclosed 'Recommended' block.

impact.note: Paste a deeplink template from Impact.com (Brand → Tracking Links → deep link). Use {url} for destination.

shareasale.note: ShareASale custom link: https://shareasale.com/r.cfm?b=BANNER&u=AFFID&m=MERCHID&urllink={url}. Fill from your account.

cj.note: CJ deep link from Link Generator. Use {url}.

merchants.name: Example merchant
merchants.note: When a bare https://example.com/... URL appears in generated content, it gets wrapped with this network's deeplinkTemplate. Remove this example and add real ones.
